heading: Publish to library
description: Describe a knowledge base and publish it so every institute can unlock and use it. Publishing makes it read-only to them — only this institute can keep editing the material.
withdrawNotice: Withdrawing a library removes it from the catalogue but never revokes access an institute has already paid for.

emptyState.title: No knowledge bases in this institute yet
emptyState.description: Create one and add its material first, then come back to describe it.

forbidden.title: This institute cannot publish to the library
forbidden.description: Libraries are published from one internal Vacademy institute.

toast.withdrawn: Withdrawn. Institutes that already unlocked it keep their access.
